messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — AcmeRetail signed for Dedicated + wants a Marketplace listing and HW partner (EdgeCloud) preflight. Need an architecture review and an implementation owner assigned. I put the customer onboarding doc here: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/ACME-EdgeCloud :eyes:
Matt: assigning myself as implementation lead for now. Can someone confirm the target timeline from sales?
Carmen: @Matt customer expects production by end of next quarter, but they want marketplace listing and joint announcement at launch. Sales asked for compliance checks first.
Jordan: FYI EdgeCloud uses a custom NIC driver and their node images are distroless-based. We should validate our runtime on their image and check kernel module compatibility.
Matt: noted. @Jordan any quick blockers you foresee for the private deployment package?
Jordan: main things: kernel module for the NIC (needs DKMS-like build) and a hermetic systemd unit that matches our service expectations. Also we should test model quantization path on their GPUs — they use A200s but with a weird microcode on some racks.
Aisha: tagging @Priya (customer SE) — can you confirm if EdgeCloud will provide a staging rack (non-prod) that we can run tests on? If not, we'll need cloud-hosted emulation.
Priya: We can get a staging rack but it's limited time — 2 weeks slot starting 2024-11-08. Also they requested we run our marketplace validation script beforehand.
Matt: good, we'll schedule kernel + runtime tests into the 2-week window. Who owns marketplace validation script run?
Carmen: partnerships can coordinate the listing metadata; engineering needs to run the validation script and provide artifacts. I'll handle the metadata and announcement checklist.
Jordan: I'll draft the test plan. Quick checklist shard:
```
- validate NIC driver build
- boot image with runtime container
- run smoke workload (50 concurrent connections)
- check KV cache warmup + latency SLOs
- quantization inference comparison (fp16 vs int8)
```
Matt: Thanks. Also need to confirm ports and firewall rules from EdgeCloud. From past SI runs:
```
Ports: 443, 50051 (gRPC), 9000-9100 (batch workers)
Outbound: allow S3 control plane endpoints
```
Aisha: tagging legal for the announcement wording later. Carmen will loop them in.
Priya: small gotcha — EdgeCloud requires a signed driver package and they scan binaries. We might need to provide reproducible build artifacts and provenance info.
Jordan: ok we'll add reproducible builds step and sign artifacts with our CI key.
Matt: deploy-bot, create a checklist ticket and CI pipeline template for the reproducible build + driver sign-off.
deploy-bot: Created checklist ticket PARTNERS-4123 and CI template branch partners/edgecloud-onboard. Status: pipeline scaffolded, please add tests. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: next steps: @Jordan create test plan by EOD Friday, @Matt schedule the 2-week staging slot, @Carmen start announcement draft and metadata. I'll coordinate a call with EdgeCloud and AcmeOps for preflight.
Carmen: will start draft and ping legal. @Priya please share contact at EdgeCloud for driver packaging requirements.
Priya: shared contact in DM.
Matt: I'll add a short runbook for rollback and capacity scaling knobs we might expose in the marketplace UI.
Jordan: will include latency/cost knobs and tracing hooks in the runbook.
Aisha: perfect. Thanks team — adding this to weekly SI sync agenda. :rocket:
